description: Header file defining the DrmSystem class for managing DRM operations on Android within the Starboard platform. It declares methods for session management, decryption, and callbacks, and includes internal data structures and member variables.

classes.name: DrmSystem
classes.description: Manages DRM sessions, decryption, and callbacks for Android DRM within the Starboard platform.

classes.name: SessionUpdateRequest
classes.description: Internal class representing a DRM session update request.

methods.name: DrmSystem
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DRM system with key system, context, and callback functions.

methods.name: GenerateSessionUpdateRequest
methods.description: Creates a session update request with specified parameters.

methods.name: UpdateSession
methods.description: Updates a DRM session with a key.

methods.name: CallDrmSessionKeyStatusesChangedCallback
methods.description: Invokes the key statuses changed callback.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if DRM system is properly initialized.

methods.name: require_secured_decoder
methods.description: Determines if a secure decoder is required based on key system.

methods.name: IsReady
methods.description: Checks if the DRM system is ready for secure input buffers.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main thread loop for the DRM system.
